caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a sleigh. The sleigh is rendered in shades of dark gray and black, with the seating area covered in a reddish-brown material. The sleigh features two long, curved runners supporting its base, which extend out in front and swirl upward at the front end. The body of the sleigh is sleek and curves smoothly to form a high backrest and sides. Thin metal supports and rods connect the runners to the main body and reinforce the structure. There are no background elements, with the sleigh set against a plain, off-white backdrop.
title: New England Cutter
